question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as the stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold this token-budget signal into the broader assemble metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: This is a public plugin API and SDK export change that third-party context engines may compile against, while a broader assemble metadata RFC remains open on the same contract surface.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` as a focused optional assemble field, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader RFC
options.body: Pause or close this branch and handle token counts together with the provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design in the open RFC.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Remove the SDK export expansion until maintainers settle the durable plugin-facing token-budget helper shape.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` as a focused optional assemble field, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and have the strongest recent history on the context-engine budget and Codex harness paths touched here.
